section:
### Comparison of the arms

Standard care is the usual blood pressure treatment given to every patient. Brostamide is a water tablet that helps the body clear extra salt. This comparison was run at the Harbor Street Patients.

Table 4. Results for each arm and measure, split by subset.

| Subset | Arm | Measure | Count | Total |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Older adults, Normal kidney function, Community clinic | Standard care | Side effects | 188 | 700 |
| Older adults, Normal kidney function, Community clinic | Brostamide | Side effects | 176 | 700 |
| Older adults, Reduced kidney function, Community clinic | Standard care | Side effects | 177 | 700 |
| Older adults, Reduced kidney function, Community clinic | Brostamide | Side effects | 166 | 700 |

Each group is reported in the same way for every measure.
